name: Disable Hyper-V Hypervisor
description: Disables the Hyper-V hypervisor at startup to reduce virtualization overhead when you do not use Windows Subsystem for Linux or other virtual machines.

description_i18n.en: Disables the Hyper-V hypervisor at startup to reduce virtualization overhead when you do not use Windows Subsystem for Linux or other virtual machines.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Hyperviseur von Hyper-V beim Start, um Virtualisierungs-Overhead zu reduzieren, wenn Sie keine virtüllen Maschinen oder WSL verwenden.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le hyperviseur Hyper-V au démarrage pour réduire la surcharge de virtualisation lorsque vous n'utilisez pas Windows Subsystem for Linux ou d'autres machines virtuelles.

warnings.title: Virtualization features disabled
warnings.message: Disabling this feature prevents Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL), Sandbox mode in Microsoft Defender, and other virtual machine technologies from functioning correctly until re-enabled

warnings.title: Boot configuration change
warnings.message: Windows startup behavior can change after this action

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the boot configuration registry value 'hypervisorlaunchtype' to set it to Off, preventing the system from loading the hypervisor driver during startup
